Managed plan

The platform price plus $0.10 per device per month, with a $199.00 monthly minimum. Includes onboarding, help integrating SuiFleet into your device image, and a support SLA as proposed scope. Confirm service availability, response commitments and exclusions in the written agreement; no SLA is activated by this page. The premium funds support time.

Getting started

At-cost tier: up to 100 devices per organization with no SuiFleet margin. Pay only network and hosting costs, estimated at about $0.01 per device per month at default settings. Billed annually in advance, with community support only. Customers paying in SUI can fund the fleet budget directly.

Design partners: up to 5,000 devices each at cost for 12 months, with managed onboarding free. Three to five companies provide regular feedback, a production reference and permission for a case study. Afterwards, partners move to list price or a pre-agreed discount. Contact us to discuss participation.

Included and configurable settings

Enrollment, staged rollouts and the dashboard are included. Live telemetry is outside the base product. Log uploads are off for new fleets; the included archive settings apply when enabled. Faster checks, health reports, longer retention and encrypted delivery can add cost. Settings are chosen per fleet and saved when you approve the change.

Fleet data

Includes 10 MB written per device per month, kept for 42 days. Additional writes: $0.10 per GB; storage: $0.05 per GB-month. Logs count as device data. Reading data back has no Walrus egress fee.

Included, optional and customer-funded costs

  • Included: the all-in subscription proposal covers network fees for the agreed reporting and storage settings. SuiFleet would fund those operating resources from the subscription; do not add the same network estimate to that bill again.
  • Optional: faster reporting, longer retention, encrypted delivery, extra data and Managed support use the prices above and the scope in your quote. Live telemetry is outside the base product.
  • Customer-funded arrangements: volume rates below about $0.07 per device assume customer-funded SUI network costs. Those rates alone are not an all-in total. A quote must identify the network costs, storage, provider services and working funds you supply separately, including any activation costs.

Request a written quote that states device capacity, reporting frequency, data volume and retention, included services, separately funded resources and the total payable. Provider services and actual workloads can change the total.

Optional detail: operating resources and network tokens

Device capacity is the number of devices your plan permits. Account approval fees pay for changes you approve. The device operating budget pays for device reports; the storage budget pays for file and log retention. These are different resources, not four subscription charges. SUI pays on-chain transactions, storage deposits and gas float; WAL pays Walrus writes and retention. Uploads can also require SUI relay fees. Saving fleet settings does not deposit money.

Explore settings in the console. Console estimates and deployment-specific tariffs are separate from a written commercial quote.

Optional detail: SUI price and renewals

Prices stay fixed in USD for the term. When a prepaid annual invoice is paid, the proposal buys 100% of the term’s estimated SUI quantity. This protects that quantity against token-price rises; gas-price or workload increases can still require more SUI. If the USD cost of SUI operations at renewal is at least 3× the quote basis, the renewal is requoted with at least 30 days’ notice. Prices never change mid-term, and falling SUI prices do not automatically reduce them.
